blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Lawyers representing victims of the drug war before the International Criminal Court (ICC) have agreed with the prosecution’s request to admit as evidence the testimonies of three witnesses on the alleged police killings during drug-related operations. In a seven-page filing dated Oct. 27, the common legal representatives of the victims (CLRVs) said admitting the testimonies of P-1370, P-1393 and P-1416 would expedite the proceedings and save valuable time and resources of the court in the crimes against humanity case against former President Rodrigo Duterte.
